Leadership

Named people, named responsibilities.

Institutions do not partner with a company; they partner with the people who will be accountable when something goes wrong. Every role on this page carries a named individual or is shown, honestly, as not yet appointed.

▲ EKORails does not describe relationships with regulators, officials or institutions as a qualification. Where an individual has held a regulated role, it is stated with the institution and the dates so that it can be verified.

Mike Ogbebor

Founder — EKORails LTD

Cross-border infrastructure and capital strategy across Houston, West Africa and the Gulf. At EKORails he is responsible for corridor strategy, institutional partner development and the regulatory engagement programme, and is accountable to the board for the delivery of the proposed pilot.

Formal title, appointment date, directorships and a full professional history for publication: [CONFIRM WITH EKORAILS]

Head of Compliance

Named compliance officer

Accountable for the AML and CFT programme, sanctions, transaction monitoring, regulatory reporting and the pre-publication review of every regulatory statement made by the company. Holds the authority to stop a transaction, a participant or a release.

Name, professional qualifications, previous regulated roles with institutions and dates, and appointment date: [CONFIRM WITH EKORAILS]

Head of Technology

Named technology lead

Accountable for platform architecture, security engineering, partner integration and operational resilience, including the independent testing programme and incident response.

Name, professional background, security qualifications and appointment date: [CONFIRM WITH EKORAILS]

Roles not yet appointed

Where a role is required for an approved pilot but is not yet filled, EKORails states that rather than distributing the responsibility across existing people on paper. Roles currently being recruited, and the point in the pathway at which each must be in place: [CONFIRM WITH EKORAILS]

Governance

How decisions are made and reviewed.

Board of directors
Directors of EKORails LTD, their appointment dates and any committee memberships: [CONFIRM WITH EKORAILS]
Compliance authority
The compliance officer reports to the board, has direct access to it, and can stop activity without requiring executive agreement.
Risk review cadence
Risk register, incidents, open regulatory matters and control exceptions reviewed on a defined cycle. Cadence: [CONFIRM WITH EKORAILS]
Advisers
Legal, regulatory and technical advisers are named only where the adviser has consented in writing to be named, and their role is described accurately rather than as endorsement.
GoBeyond Advisory
GoBeyond Advisory’s role in relation to EKORails LTD — whether as strategic development partner, adviser or otherwise — is described only where it is legally and factually accurate. EKORails LTD is the legal applicant and the operating entity. Exact relationship and any contractual basis for describing it: [CONFIRM WITH EKORAILS]
Conflicts of interest
Declared, recorded and managed under a written policy. Directors and officers declare outside interests that could affect corridor, partner or vendor decisions.

Want to meet the people accountable for this?

Partner and regulator conversations are held with the named individuals responsible, not with a sales function.
